title: LibRPA dies with 'transport retry counter exceeded' on individual bad nodes
symptom: Two runs lost to OFI/verbs communication errors on specific nodes (c21380, c21370, rank 8), log tail 'BAD TERMINATION'; a misleading 'Cosine transform duality error: 12722.3' appears nearby; a retry then hits OUT_OF_MEMORY.
root_cause: Node-level fabric faults, not the physics input; shrinking nfreq does not address cross-node communication stability.
minimal_fix: Identify the failing node from rank logs, exclude it (scheduler exclude list) and resubmit LibRPA-only; for memory pressure move to the large-memory partition (e.g. 9 nodes x 1 rank x 96 OMP threads, --mem=380000).
validation: Runs complete after node exclusion / partition move.
avoid: Cutting nfreq to 'fix' a communication fault; rerunning on the same bad node.

parameters.scheduler: exclude failing node; large-memory partition for OOM retries
